card.name: Final piece of sevelamer and Epidiolex
card.fires_on: The last piece of the drug names sevelamer ("amer" after "sevel") and Epidiolex ("LEX" after "EPIDIO") in drug label text.

modes.label: Sevelamer ending
modes.description: The "amer" piece completing sevelamer, often before carbonate tablets.
modes.example: Titrate by 0.8 g Dose Titration for Pediatric Patients Taking Sevel<<amer>> Carbonate Tablets.

modes.label: Epidiolex ending
modes.description: The "LEX" piece completing the capitalized brand name EPIDIOLEX.
modes.example: Hypersensitivity to cannabidiol or any of the ingredients in EPIDIO<<LEX>> ( 4 )

card.plain: It lights up when a long drug name, mainly sevelamer or Epidiolex, is just about to be finished.
